# 实施方案: W10T6

## 任务概述

| 字段 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Wave | W10 — Dispatch |
| Task | W10T6 — Full dispatch unit tests: path return, threshold boundaries, feature gate combos, nested guard, non-contiguous penalty |
| 目标文件 | `src/dispatch.rs (#[cfg(test)])` |
| 前置依赖 | W10T4, W10T5, W10T2, W10T3 |
| 设计文档 | 30-dispatch.md |
| 预估工时 | 20 min |

## 目标

按 `30-dispatch.md §8.2` 完整清单、`§8.3` 边界场景、`§8.4` 属性不变量，编写 dispatch 模块剩余的单元测试。这些测试与 W10T1-W10T5 中已落地的单元测试共同构成完整的 dispatch 测试矩阵。

所有测试均按 `30-dispatch.md §5.5` 的真实签名调用 `select_exec_path(len, is_contiguous, alignment_ok)`、`should_parallelize(len, is_contiguous)`，**不传入** `ParallelExecStrategy` 参数。

## 前置准备

- 确认 W8 tensor 查询方法可提供 len、contiguous 与 alignment 信息。
- 确认 dispatch 为 `src/dispatch.rs` 单文件模块。
- 按 `30-dispatch.md §5` 保持 API 为 crate 内部使用。
- 确认 W10T4 已实现 `select_exec_path` / `should_parallelize`；W10T5 已实现 `set/reset_*_threshold`。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 补充剩余的单元测试

依据 `30-dispatch.md §8.2` 测试清单与 §8.3 边界场景，编写前序 task 未实现的剩余测试。本 Step 是 W10T6 唯一的 Step，全部内容为测试代码——与 TEMPLATE.md「最后一个 Step 必须为单元测试」一致。

> **测试规约**：
> - 所有禁用 parallel 的测试使用 `set_parallel_threshold(0)` 作为 sentinel（`30-dispatch.md §5.6` line 494-499），**不**使用 `usize::MAX`。
> - 涉及 `try_acquire_guard()` 或 outer-guard 持有的测试加 `#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]`。
> - 涉及 `ExecPath::Simd` 的测试加 `#[cfg(feature = "simd")]`。
> - 每个改写阈值的测试在结束前必须 `reset_*_threshold()`，避免污染其他测试。

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    // === Path selection — Serial ===
    #[test]
    fn test_exec_path_serial_below_threshold() {
        // Default thresholds: parallel=65536, simd=64. len=1 is below both.
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(1, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Serial);
        assert!(guard.is_none());
    }

    // === Path selection — Parallel ===
    #[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
    #[test]
    fn test_exec_path_parallel_above_threshold() {
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(usize::MAX, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Parallel);
        assert!(guard.is_some());
        drop(guard);
    }

    // === Path selection — SIMD ===
    #[cfg(feature = "simd")]
    #[test]
    fn test_exec_path_simd_when_aligned() {
        // 30-dispatch §5.6 line 494-499: threshold=0 is the parallel-disable sentinel.
        set_parallel_threshold(0);
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(DEFAULT_SIMD_THRESHOLD, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Simd);
        assert!(guard.is_none());
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    // === Non-contiguous penalty ===
    #[test]
    fn test_exec_path_serial_when_noncontiguous_below_doubled_threshold() {
        // 30-dispatch §5.6 line 541: non-contiguous needs len >= 2*threshold.
        set_parallel_threshold(100);
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(199, false, true);
        assert_ne!(path, ExecPath::Parallel);
        assert!(guard.is_none());
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "simd")]
    #[test]
    fn test_simd_rejected_when_noncontiguous() {
        // SIMD requires contiguous; non-contiguous must not select Simd.
        set_parallel_threshold(0); // disable parallel via sentinel
        let (path, _guard) = select_exec_path(DEFAULT_SIMD_THRESHOLD, false, true);
        assert_ne!(path, ExecPath::Simd);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Serial);
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    // === Alignment hint pass-through ===
    #[cfg(feature = "simd")]
    #[test]
    fn test_simd_allows_misaligned_hint_when_contiguous() {
        // 30-dispatch §5.5 line 403-410: alignment_ok=false must NOT close SIMD.
        set_parallel_threshold(0); // disable parallel via sentinel
        let (path, _guard) = select_exec_path(DEFAULT_SIMD_THRESHOLD, true, false);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Simd);
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    // === Priority: Parallel > SIMD ===
    #[cfg(all(feature = "parallel", feature = "simd"))]
    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_preferred_over_simd_for_large_input() {
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(usize::MAX, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Parallel);
        assert!(guard.is_some());
        drop(guard);
    }

    // === Feature gate combos ===
    #[cfg(not(feature = "parallel"))]
    #[test]
    fn test_no_parallel_feature_never_returns_parallel() {
        let (path, _guard) = select_exec_path(usize::MAX, true, true);
        assert_ne!(path, ExecPath::Parallel);
    }

    #[cfg(not(feature = "simd"))]
    #[test]
    fn test_no_simd_feature_never_returns_simd() {
        set_parallel_threshold(0); // disable parallel via sentinel
        let (path, _guard) = select_exec_path(usize::MAX, true, true);
        assert_ne!(path, ExecPath::Simd);
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    // === Determinism ===
    #[test]
    fn test_deterministic_same_input_same_output() {
        reset_parallel_threshold();
        let first = select_exec_path(1, true, true).0;
        let second = select_exec_path(1, true, true).0;
        assert_eq!(first, second);
    }

    // === Boundary: length extremes (§8.3) ===
    #[test]
    fn test_len_zero_returns_serial() {
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(0, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Serial);
        assert!(guard.is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_len_one_returns_serial() {
        let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(1, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Serial);
        assert!(guard.is_none());
    }

    // === Boundary: threshold edges (§8.3) ===
    #[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_threshold_boundary() {
        set_parallel_threshold(100);
        // Exactly at threshold → eligible for parallel.
        let (path, _guard) = select_exec_path(100, true, true);
        assert_eq!(path, ExecPath::Parallel);
        // One below threshold → should NOT be parallel.
        let (path2, _guard2) = select_exec_path(99, true, true);
        assert_ne!(path2, ExecPath::Parallel);
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
    #[test]
    fn test_noncontiguous_doubled_threshold_boundary() {
        set_parallel_threshold(100);
        // Non-contiguous: threshold × 2 = 200. 199 → not eligible; 200 → eligible.
        let (path, _guard) = select_exec_path(199, false, true);
        assert_ne!(path, ExecPath::Parallel);
        let (path2, _guard2) = select_exec_path(200, false, true);
        assert_eq!(path2, ExecPath::Parallel);
        reset_parallel_threshold();
    }

    // === Property: Monotonic path grade (§8.4) ===
    fn path_grade(path: ExecPath) -> u8 {
        match path {
            ExecPath::Serial => 0,
            ExecPath::Simd => 1,
            ExecPath::Parallel => 2,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_monotonic_path_grade() {
        // For increasing len with same other params, path grade never decreases.
        // 30-dispatch §8.4: Serial < Simd < Parallel
        let get_grade = |len: usize| -> u8 {
            let (path, guard) = select_exec_path(len, true, true);
            drop(guard);
            path_grade(path)
        };
        let sizes = [0usize, 1, 63, 64, 65_535, 65_536, 65_537];
        let mut max_so_far: u8 = 0;
        for &len in &sizes {
            let grade = get_grade(len);
            assert!(
                grade >= max_so_far,
                "monotonic violation: len={len}, grade={grade}, max_so_far={max_so_far}"
            );
            max_so_far = grade;
        }
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| Parallel 优先于 SIMD | `30-dispatch.md §6.1` 规定大输入先尝试并行 |
| ParallelGuard 与 Parallel 返回值绑定 | `30-dispatch.md §5.7` 消除选择后进入失败的中间状态 |
| 阈值使用 Relaxed 原子 | `30-dispatch.md §6.3` 只需运行时配置可见性 |
| 用 `set_parallel_threshold(0)` 而非 `usize::MAX` 禁用并行 | `30-dispatch.md §5.6` line 494-499 显式 sentinel |
| 涉及 `try_acquire_guard` / outer-guard 的测试加 `#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]` | 与 W10T2 / W10T4 cfg 守护一致，避免 cfg-off 时编译失败 |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check --all-features`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
3. 测试验证: `cargo test dispatch --all-features` 和不同 feature 组合下的 `cargo test dispatch`
4. 手动验证: 使用 `-- --nocapture` 检查阈值重置测试不会互相污染。

## 注意事项

- `ParallelGuard` 不提供公开构造函数。
- 阈值测试必须 reset，避免影响同模块其他测试。
- feature 关闭时模块仍编译，并回落到 Serial 或可用路径。
- 本 task 的所有测试以及 W10T2-W10T5 已落地的测试共同覆盖 `30-dispatch.md §8.2` 完整清单（19 个测试函数）、§8.3 边界场景、§8.4 属性不变量。
